jobs.description: Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. A core part of making this possible is predicting the future: How much will customers order? How long will new inventory take to arrive? What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more. We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement. We need your skills to help us push the boundaries of what's possible. Amazon's SCOT Forecasting team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager-Tech with a proven ability to influence across multiple organizations and drive innovation at scale. In this role, you will define and drive the long-term vision for both established and greenfield forecasting products within an ever-evolving supply chain landscape. You will partner closely with scientists and engineers to build interfaces for state-of-the-art deep learning-based systems that generate the predictions and estimates required to optimize Amazon's supply chain at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how we bring advanced science — including Deep Learning, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models — out of the lab and into production systems that serve Amazon's worldwide supply chain. And we're focused on doing it faster than ever Key job responsibilities Specifically, as a Sr PM-T in forecasting, you will be responsible for: - Working backwards from customer problems to define the 3-5 year vision for Forecasting products, and working with scientists and engineering to achieve that vision - Driving strategic communications (e.g. decision narratives, investment proposals) - Communicating, earning trust, and influencing stakeholders from multiple organizations - Working backwards from customers in the supply chain and business units to proactively identify opportunities - Experimenting and scaling new products and models from prototype to production worldwide - Diving into technical solutions and alternatives to understand areas of opportunity, defects, and customer needs A day in the life Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include: - Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage - Maternity and Parental Leave Options - Paid Time Off (PTO) - 401(k) Plan If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an API engineer to join our core API team and help scale Runway's platform serving millions of users and handling thousands of requests per second. You'll work on the critical infrastructure that powers both our public API (used by external developers) and internal tools, managing user data, task orchestration, billing, permissions, and asset management. This is a high-impact role on a mature, production system. You'll build enterprise features, optimize database performance, design async workflows, and ensure reliability at scale. If you're passionate about API development, love TypeScript, and want to own systems end-to-end, this is the role for you. A PEEK AT OUR TECHNICAL STACK Our API endpoints for real-time collaboration and media asset management is written in TypeScript, and runs in ECS containers on AWS Fargate. We leverage multiple AWS-native components, such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Kinesis, and SQS, as building blocks of our infrastructure. Our inference backend is written in Python (PyTorch, TorchScript), and is deployed across multiple clusters / cloud providers. jobs.description: TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity. WHY LOVABLE? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure. - A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products. - Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control. - Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols. - Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases. - Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions. - A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week. - Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations. - Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem. - Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps. - Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale. - Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable. - Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces. - Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t. Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable. ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Rocket Delivery（火箭速配）：提供多元商品的次日送達服務，兼具便利與價格競爭力。
Rocket Overseas（火箭跨境）：提供來自韓國、美國等全球熱門市場數百萬件熱銷商品的國際免運服務。
我們正在尋找優秀人才，一同參與 Coupang 在台灣的快速成長。如果你希望加入高速發展的電商與物流產業，並打造讓消費者驚豔的購物體驗，歡迎加入我們。
職務簡介
身為 物流安全暨損失預防經理（Security & Loss Prevention Manager），你將隸屬於 Coupang Global Security（CGS）全球安全團隊，負責確保公司安全及損失預防政策在台灣物流營運據點的落實執行。
你將透過風險識別、事件預防、即時應變及調查機制，保護公司員工、客戶、營運流程及企業資產，降低各類風險對品牌聲譽及業務營運造成的影響。
此職位需與物流營運團隊密切合作，負責：
建立安全管理制度
防範竊盜、詐欺及內外部風險
執行損失預防計畫
進行安全事件調查與改善
監督第三方保全服務品質

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Overseas” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview
As a Logistics Security & Loss Prevention (S&LP) Manager, you will be part of Coupang Global Security (CGS) team and program. You will ensure that CGS Policies and Standards are implemented. You will support the delivery of our business targets and the strengthening of our brand by managing security and loss prevention risks that could impact our employees and customers, affect our business operations, inflict damages to our tangible and non-tangible assets and have adverse impact on our company brand and reputation. You will achieve these objectives by identifying vulnerabilities, preventing risks, responding to on-going incidents and investigating thoroughly security and loss prevention (S&LP) incidents to identify and mitigate root causes to prevent recurrence.
The LPM reports into the Taiwan Sr. Manager, Security & Loss Prevention | Logistics.
This role covers a 24/7 operation, and you must be flexible to, when necessary, work all shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays Work weekends and/or overnight shifts.

Prepare Taiwan S&LP Weekly Business Review deck. Track and report on key performance indicators
Inspire performance excellence on the part of all security services team members and third-party vendors. Lead the way to ensure that Master Service Agreement is met and/or exceeds exceptions. Hold vendors accountable to meet customer demands

3+ years of experience in law enforcement, security, loss prevention, risk management, supply chain management, or other related field
Proven loss prevention program exposure, including experience in a distribution environment,
Demonstrable ability to proactively gather the right data from appropriate sources, while considering all the facts and other perspectives

Preferred Qualifications

Communication skills. Ability to identify the customer’s expectation, adjusting language and style to suit the listener

Experience with varies business types such as, logistics, warehouse, distribution center, multi-site loss management.
Interviewing and Interrogation experience beneficial such as Wicklander and Zulawski, LPQ, CPP, LPC, CFI or other certifications is a plus

About Coupang
At Coupang, we're revolutionizing the e-commerce experience, from the moment a customer opens our app to the moment their order arrives. Our retail and logistics network has shattered the tradeoffs between speed, selection, and price. In Coupang, we're rapidly scaling our Rocket Delivery and Rocket Overseas services in Taiwan.
The role
We're hiring a Senior PM to join our Supply Chain Management technology team, leading the design, development, and localization of Coupang's supply chain management products. In this role, you'll own one or more product areas across ordering, inbound placement and schedule, inventory management, transfers, and network design — the systems that decide what to buy, where to send it, when, and how to move it across our FC network. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous environment, partnering with data science, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes.
The work is science-heavy
Most of what you'll ship has a mathematical model, optimization, ML, or agentic decision-model component at its core. Our architecture combines LLM-based agents with deterministic MIP solvers and ML models: LLMs orchestrate the workflow; solvers and ML models compute the answer. You'll partner daily with our SCM engineering and data science teams, who together own the systems, models, and solvers. Your job is to shape what those systems decide, what they optimize for, and where they hand off to human stakeholders.
What you'll do
Own what to build and why for your product area(s).
Write PRDs: problem statement, goals and metrics, scope (in/out), functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, open questions.
Own the product roadmap, backlog, and KPIs end-to-end. Prioritize and sequence with reasoning documented; make scope tradeoffs in writing.
Drive PRD sign-off with the right stakeholders (retail/catalog, warehouse operations, instock, category management, S&OP, inbound planning) on business use cases, scope, and exit criteria. Align parity/disparity decisions with your counterpart PMs.
Conduct UAT against the acceptance criteria you wrote, a functional check that the feature meets requirements.
Work directly with business and operations stakeholders.
Instock managers, S&OP, IPC/CT, category managers, buyers, and FC operations are your primary customers. You'll spend real time with them, sitting with instock manages, buyers, and planners, walking FC floors, understanding what actually breaks. Translate operational pain into product bets. Serve as the strategic bridge between local operations, business teams, and global tech.
Ship AI/ML/OR-integrated products from ideation to launch.
Partner with data science and engineering on ordering, scheduling, placement, inventory rebalancing, and other decision systems in our AI-enabled fulfillment centers. Define success metrics, drive A/B testing, and iterate based on real-time data.
Identify new opportunities across ordering, fulfillment planning, inventory management, and network design.
Deeply analyze data, including unstructured operational data, to size levers and drive cost efficiencies.
Prototype rapidly.
Use AI tools and advanced analytics to reduce time from ideation to proof-old the first-pass analysis, run the numbers yourself.
You should have
Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative discipline.
5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of shipping products at scale. E-commerce, logistics, or supply chain tech are strongly preferred.
Shipped at least one non-trivial optimization or ML-backed product to production (e.g., procurement, routing, dynamic pricing etc.).
Fluency in English: reading, writing, and speaking. You will write PRDs, technical specs, and executive updates in English, and work daily with global engineering and DS teams in English.
Proven ability to translate complex operational processes into scalable, AI-integrated business solutions from conception to deployment.
A forward-thinking mindset with a strong ability to use AI tools (GenAI, LLMs, agents) to accelerate product development, extract insights from unstructured data, and prototype hypotheses.
Hands-on data fluency. SQL to the level of writing your own analysis queries.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, and collaborate effectively with data science, engineering, and operational teams.
A relentless bias for action and ownership. Willingness to bridge high-level strategy and tactical operational execution.
Nice to have
Deep experience designing and launching advanced planning products (fulfillment center planning, automated inventory management, route scheduling, network capacity design).
Experience with vendor-facing systems (e.g., SRMS, PO management) and inbound planning and operations.
Experience shipping AI-agent products — spec'ing an agent's tools, guardrails, and human handoffs.
Python enough to prototype and read DS code.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
쿠팡 및 쿠팡 계열사에서는 Finance 관점에서 Business Partner 역할을 하는 FP&A(재무분석/기획) 담당자를 찾고 있습니다. 빠르게 성장하는 비즈니스의 경쟁력을 강화할 수 있는 재무전략에 대한 경험, 뛰어난 분석 역량을 갖추신 분들을 찾습니다. Financial Modeling 경험은 필수로, Corporate Finance 경력 없으신 IB/회계법인 출신 분들도 환영합니다.
본 공고는 쿠팡 및 쿠팡 계열사의 다양한 비즈니스의 FP&A 채용 통합공고로, 이력서 접수 후 선호도, 경력 연차 및 역량에 따라 세부 비즈니스를 후보자 분께 제안 드리고 있습니다. 지원 시에는 반드시 상세 경력 사항이 담긴 자유 양식의 국문 이력서를 제출 부탁드립니다.
현업 인터뷰: 단순한 숫자 검증을 넘어 비즈니스 전략의 파트너로, 쿠팡 FP&A를 만나다
업무 내용
1. 재무 보고 및 예산/계획 수립
정기적인 Financial Reporting 및 Forecast modeling 수행
사업 목표 설정 및 실적 개선 방안 모색, 다양한 재무 목표를 달성하기 위한 세부 활동 다양화
2. 주요 성과 관리
비즈니스 조직별 상세 목표 가이드
KPI 정의 및 이를 자동화/수량화 하여 목표에 대한 진행 상황을 실시간으로 파악하고 적시에 조치를 취할 수 있도록 지원
사업적으로 긴급/중요한 문제에 대해 현업과 함께 문제 해결 (Root Cause 파악)
3. 재무 분석
예산과 실적 비교 분석, 예상 자료에 대한 깊이 있는 분석
비즈니스 인텔리전스 툴을 활용하여 자동 보고서 생성에 기여하여, 지속적인 효율성 향상 프로그램 일환으로 활용

jobs.description: Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen. Key job responsibilities Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk A day in the life Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren. Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften. Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln. About the team Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen. Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.
